boundary: This is a strengthened rigorous lower bound, not the complete global singleton coefficient.
theorem: A completed deterministic 2,000-support exact search certifies 263 weight-six singleton fibers. Full PGSp(4,3) canonicalization proves that the witnesses occupy 263 pairwise disjoint regular orbits of size 51,840, so the global U6 singleton coefficient is at least 13,633,920.
